# `Q-2-15` — Unclosed Strong Underscore Emphasis

> A `__strong__` run opens with `__` but no closing `__` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Double-underscore strong emphasis (`__text__`) must be balanced
inside the same block. This error fires when an opening `__`
appears without a matching close before the block ends.

## Why this happens

Most often a typo, or a literal `__` pair (e.g. `__init__`) read
as an emphasis opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `__`, or escape the underscores when they belong
to a literal token:

```markdown
The `\_\_init\_\_` method.
```

## Example

```markdown
__
```
